description: This file defines internal seed material functions and constants for the Abseil C++ library's random number generation, including seed entropy handling, seed mixing, and salt retrieval.

methods.name: SeedBitsToBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of 32-bit blocks needed to contain a given number of bits.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromURBG
methods.description: Fills a span of uint32_t values using a URBG to generate seed material.

methods.name: MixIntoSeedMaterial
methods.description: Mixes a sequence of values into seed material to enhance entropy.

methods.name: GetSaltMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves a salt value, possibly for seeding or entropy purposes.
